hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Traverse the binary tree in bottom-up post-order fashion.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: From each child subtree, return the maximum value present.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: A node is dominant if its value strictly exceeds both left and right subtree maximums.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Post-order traversal computes subtree maxima in linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-scanning subtrees from scratch for each node scales as O(n^2).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Recursion call stack consumes depth proportional memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Computes subtree properties bottom-up via post-order traversal.
